_source.pages: 2 and 7 for the coverage words, 7 for the map, 24 to 26 for every branch
_source.method: read out of the profile PDF by word coordinates, with the two branch columns kept apart and the map labels split on their own drawing positions. Never from memory, never from a summary, never from an earlier extract.
_source.correction: REBUILT 12 September 2026 after three faults were found in the first read. ONE: the branch pages print in TWO COLUMNS, and reading them as flowing text paired every branch name with the NEXT branch's address, so Kanye's address, phone and email were printed under Commerce Park, about 85 km away. TWO: Kanye, BDF SSKB Camp, Letlhakeng and Shoshong were missing from the app altogether. THREE: the coverage page is a MAP, and neighbouring town labels were glued into place names that do not exist, such as Bobonong Gabojango and Dinokwe Shoshong, so the app would refuse real towns and accept invented ones.
_source.guard: Every branch whose email is printed must carry an email whose local part matches its own name. The only exceptions the profile itself prints are the head office on info@, the two Francistown depots sharing frwexpress@ and Maun Express on mubexpress@. checkEmailsMatchBranches() enforces it and a test fails if a new read breaks it.

coverage_claim: more than 50 towns, villages and cities nationwide and operates the biggest privately owned and extensive network covering over 75 sites on a daily basis
coverage_note: Both lines are the profile's own words, quoted. The profile says over 50 branches on page 2 and never says 55. Counted off the branch pages there are 30 offices and 27 service points in Botswana with a printed address, plus 3 offices in South Africa.

unresolved.name: Ramotswa
unresolved.why: The profile prints this heading and a phone number with no address beside it, and a second Ramotswa with a full address appears on the next page. It is not offered as a collection point until a person confirms whether these are one place or two. Owner: Barbara.

towns_note: These are labels lifted off a drawing, not a printed list, so they are treated as likely covered rather than certain. A town here with no branch of its own is carried to, not collected from, and the office confirms before anything is promised.
